meta_description: Bradford Gardening Services in Leeds offers professional garden maintenance, landscaping, and design. Expert local gardeners. Call 07597 177445 for a free quote today.
hero_subhead: From overgrown borders to complete landscape design, we transform Leeds gardens into outdoor spaces you'll love.
services_subhead: We handle everything from weekly maintenance and hedge trimming to full landscape redesigns and seasonal planting schemes.

services.title: Garden Maintenance
services.desc: Weekly or fortnightly grass cutting, hedge trimming, and border upkeep. We keep your garden looking sharp without the work.

services.title: Landscaping & Design
services.desc: Custom patio layouts, new planting schemes, and hardscaping projects. We turn your garden vision into reality with expert planning and execution.

services.title: Hedge & Tree Trimming
services.desc: Professional pruning and reshaping using proper techniques. Keeps trees healthy and maintains sight lines and boundaries.

services.title: Garden Clearance
services.desc: We tackle overgrown gardens and remove unwanted vegetation quickly and efficiently, leaving you with a clean slate.

services.title: Seasonal Planting
services.desc: Spring bulbs, summer bedding, and autumn plantings chosen to suit your garden's light and soil. Colour and interest all year round.

services.title: Patio & Pathway Installation
services.desc: New patios, stepping stones, and pathways built to last. We source quality materials and ensure proper drainage and levels.

about_pullquote: A well-kept garden makes your home feel welcoming. That's what drives us.
about_para_1: Bradford Gardening Services has been transforming Leeds gardens for over two decades. We started because we believed gardening expertise shouldn't be hard to find or expensive to afford. Today we've helped hundreds of homeowners enjoy their outdoor spaces without the stress of maintenance.
about_para_2: Our reputation rests on showing up on time, doing thorough work, and treating your garden like it matters—because it does. We listen to what you want, offer honest advice, and never leave a job half-done. Most of our work now comes from returning customers and word of mouth.

reviews.text: Our garden was an absolute mess—completely overgrown—and I didn't know where to start. The lads came round, cleared it all out, and put in a proper patio with new borders. They were tidy, professional, and finished exactly when they said. Really impressed. Would use them again in a heartbeat.
reviews.author: Mark T.

reviews.text: Been using Bradford Gardening for about three years now. Come every fortnight to keep on top of the grass and hedges. Never let us down, always on time, and the price is fair. My garden looks better than it ever has. Can't fault them.
reviews.author: Jennifer H.

reviews.text: Had a consultation about redesigning our back garden—they listened to what we wanted, gave practical advice, and didn't push us into expensive extras. Work started on time, quality was brilliant, and the whole thing took less time than they quoted. Couldn't be happier.
reviews.author: David P.
